newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain sees 97 deficit/gdp ratio hitting 3pct target.
newsitem.headline: Spain sees 97 deficit/gdp ratio hitting 3pct target.

text.p: Budget Secretary Jose Folgado said on Wednesday that Spain is on track to meet its 1997 target of lowering the public-sector deficit to three percent of gross domestic product.

"For the whole year, we are sure we'll meet the targets we have both in the convergence plan and in the budget," Folgado told reporters in a news conference presenting first quarter 1997 budget deficit data.
Spain reported earlier that the first-quarter deficit stood at 1.1 percent of GDP, but Folgado said it would be an error to multiple that value by four to get the full-year deficit figure.
"We can't multiple the deficit/gdp percentage we had in the first quarter by four... We had brought-forward payments, and delayed revenues," Folgado added.
"We can't do that, because total expenditures won't be the expenditures we had by four, and the total revenues won't be the revenues we had by four," he explained.
